methodology: Bundled web-design-guidelines references/command.md; reviewed both modified source files and all after screenshots

findings.finding: Destructive button and severity text contrast below 4.5:1
findings.status: fixed; dark text on semantic danger and warning tokens

findings.finding: Interactive controls lacked intentional keyboard focus
Authentication inputs lacked persistent labels and autocomplete
findings.status: fixed; visible associated labels, autocomplete and name attributes

findings.finding: Icon-only monitor controls lacked accessible names
Mobile header, monitor grids and user management overflowed viewport
findings.status: fixed; wrapped controls, minmax tracks and responsive layout

findings.finding: Modal scrolling and content containment undefined
findings.status: fixed; viewport-safe sizing and contained scroll

findings.finding: Initial snapshot image had empty src and no intrinsic dimensions
findings.status: fixed; valid initial transparent SVG, dimensions and hidden empty runtime preview

findings.finding: Dynamic incident/user/report fields lacked accessible names
findings.status: fixed; translated aria-labels in presentation templates

findings.finding: Existing click-only feed selection lacks keyboard equivalent
findings.status: deferred; changing handlers or interaction violates explicit zero-behavior-change scope

findings.finding: Existing modals do not implement focus management or Escape handling
findings.status: deferred; behavioral accessibility requires separate approved scope

findings.finding: Existing emoji presentation used by runtime mute state and translated actions
findings.status: deferred; preserve existing textContent behavior and dictionaries
deferred; existing navigation behavior outside visual scope

limitations: No real WebRTC/mediasoup stream, stereo VU audio, snapshot capture, clip playback, reconnect or live P1 audio tested.
REST data is browser-intercepted fixture data; server authorization, mutations and persistence were not integration-tested.
Export action wiring is unchanged; actual backend CSV and printer output are not tested.
